start_with: Confirm that the page supplies the intended entity in context.
Confirm that the Documents block’s Entity Type matches that context.
Inspect the block’s selected Document Types.
Inspect the document type’s Entity Type and any qualifier column and value.
Confirm that the document type is manually selectable if a user is trying to add it manually.
Confirm that any maximum-documents limit has not been reached. (Configure Entity Documents, Add the Block)
branches.title: A document type is missing from the Documents block
branches.when: A document type is missing from the Documents block

do_not_assume: Stop if they do not match.
start_with: Identify the workflow entity type.
Identify the selected document type’s configured entity type.
Stop if they do not match.
Inspect the document type’s associated file type.
Check whether required preferred-file settings reject the uploaded file.
For a person document, verify Edit permission on both the document type and the Person Document file type.
If the problem concerns access after upload, determine whether the installation predates the Rock 17.8 linkage fix. (Add Documents Using Workflows, Rock Core Release Notes)
branches.title: An Entity Document Add workflow fails
branches.when: An Entity Document Add workflow fails

do_not_assume: Do not broaden permissions until the precise failing layer and version are established.
start_with: Identify whether this is an entity document, merge template, unsigned signature request, or completed signature document.
For an entity document, inspect document-type, associated file-type, block, and any per-document security relevant to the installed version.
For a completed signature document on Rock 19.0, inspect associated binary file-type permissions.
For direct signed-document downloads on Rock 19.5 or later, inspect signature-template security and confirm the relevant fix is installed.
Do not broaden permissions until the precise failing layer and version are established. (Manage Entity Documents, Manage Signature Documents, Rock Core Release Notes)
branches.title: A user cannot view or download a document
branches.when: A user cannot view or download a document

start_with: Replace curved quotation marks with straight quotation marks.
Check whether the template uses unsupported Word features: `if`, `raw`, or `lava` tags, Lava commands, or shortcodes.
Inspect the available merge fields for the actual grid source.
If the source contains GroupMember rows, use the exposed person row and access membership data through `Row.GroupMember`.
Check whether `{% Next %}` is present and whether the desired output is one complete document per row or multiple rows in one layout. (Create a Merge Document, Using Lava with Merge Documents)
branches.title: Lava fails in a Word merge template
branches.when: Lava fails in a Word merge template

start_with: Confirm the source row and merge field contain the email value.
Confirm the problem occurs in HTML merge output rather than in the underlying grid.
If Cloudflare is in the request path, inspect whether Scrape Shield is enabled.
If enabled, evaluate disabling Scrape Shield for the relevant zone because the official documentation identifies it as blocking email addresses in HTML merge documents.
Regenerate a bounded test document and verify the output. (Create a Merge Document)
branches.title: Email addresses are missing from an HTML merge document
branches.when: Email addresses are missing from an HTML merge document

start_with: Inspect the fixed **Signature Document Template** action setting.
Inspect the dynamic template ID, GUID, or workflow attribute.
If both are populated, treat the fixed template as authoritative because it takes precedence.
Confirm that the selected template is active; Rock 16.1 fixed inactive-template filtering in workflow actions.
Confirm that attribute values contain the expected ID or GUID representation. (Use Electronic Signatures in a Workflow, Rock Core Release Notes)
branches.title: A workflow uses the wrong signature template
branches.when: A workflow uses the wrong signature template

start_with: Identify the document’s Applies To person.
Identify its Assigned To person.
Identify the recorded Signed By person.
For workflows, inspect the mapped Person attributes and whether the signer was logged in.
For event registration, confirm whether the registrant is classified as an adult or child.
Confirm the person completing the registration when a child is the registrant.

Check whether missing birthdate data makes the adult/child classification unreliable. (Intro to Electronic Signatures, Use Electronic Signatures in a Workflow, Use Electronic Signatures in Event Registrations)
branches.title: The wrong person is expected to sign
branches.when: The wrong person is expected to sign

start_with: Confirm the external registration page uses the Obsidian Registration Entry block.
Confirm the required template is a current built-in electronic-signature template rather than a legacy-provider document.
Inspect the registration template’s Required Signature Document selection.
Confirm the registrant’s person match, signature-document relationship, required template, and validity.
Determine whether the installation includes the Rock 18.3 registrant relationship fix and migration. (Use Electronic Signatures in Event Registrations, Rock Core Release Notes)
branches.title: Event registration signatures break or display the wrong document
branches.when: Event registration signatures break or display the wrong document

start_with: Separate rendering from communication delivery: first determine whether the signed PDF exists.
Inspect the signature template’s file type and completion System Communication.
Inspect the **PDF External Render Endpoint** system setting.
Determine whether the host can run Puppeteer or Chrome.
If local rendering is supported, review whether concurrent volume is exhausting server capacity.
If external rendering is required, verify endpoint configuration and reachability without exposing credentials.
After PDF generation succeeds, troubleshoot the completion email through the communications system. (Generate PDFs for Electronic Signature Documents, Set Up Electronic Signatures)
branches.title: A signed PDF is not generated or delivery stalls
branches.when: A signed PDF is not generated or delivery stalls

entrypoint: Choose the branch whose symptom matches the user's task, then inspect the live records before making changes.
